§3§lChecking channels§r
Shift-right-click air to open the Quantum Terminal interface and check used channels, total capacity, percentage, incorporated-device count and the channels those devices actually use. Press E or Esc to close the interface. The percentage uses the red overload color only when usage exceeds total capacity. Tick this quest after understanding capacity and overload handling.

§3§lCapacity and warnings§r
Controller capacity is exposed faces × §132§r channels; shared faces between neighboring controllers are excluded at both ends. Each node bridge carries up to §132§r channels. When a node gains channels and total usage reaches at least §195%§r without exceeding capacity, it triggers a chat warning; remaining in that range does not continuously repeat the warning.

§3§lOverload and expansion§r
§cAn overload lasting 3 minutes detonates the entire controller structure; returning within capacity during the countdown cancels the explosion.§r With AE2 infinite channels enabled, §2there is no channel cap or overload explosion§r. Check usage after adding devices, reserve capacity before expansion, and remove idle nodes when necessary.
